result.summary: Offer a fixed-scope local-business website fix package: find one visible conversion bug on a real site, repair it, and sell the outcome as a 3-day one-issue fix with CobrAMO payment reference RANK-IAMO506.
result.opportunity: Many small local businesses have public websites with one obvious conversion blocker such as hidden phone numbers, dead booking CTAs, broken WhatsApp links, outdated contact details, poor mobile spacing, or slow mobile pages. The issue is visible to the owner, easy to explain in a single sentence, and directly tied to lost leads. This is more concrete than a broad SEO retainer and more likely to convert than a generic dashboard or review-monitoring service.
result.target_customer: Small local service businesses in Spain with a public website and active Google Business Profile: dental clinics, beauty clinics, locksmiths, home services, legal offices, and similar businesses that rely on phone, WhatsApp, or form leads.
result.offer: Website Fix Pack: 1-page public-site audit, identify the top conversion bug, fix the issue in the live site or a staging copy, add or repair a clear WhatsApp/call CTA, and deliver a simple before/after summary with screenshots. Scope capped at one visible issue across up to 3 pages and a 3-day turnaround.
result.price: 149 EUR fixed-scope fix / 299 EUR if the owner wants a second issue or a small landing-page follow-up
result.why_now: Google Search Central and Google Business Profile guidance show that local trust, mobile usability, and page experience shape how businesses are discovered and converted; many local businesses still have outdated contact flows or weak mobile pages. This creates a direct ROI story: fix a visible friction point, increase calls and WhatsApp leads, and keep the engagement short, fixed, and easy to validate.
